mutant.observed: ALL SIX CAUGHT in-repo, each by a named arm. AND THE PROOF EARNED ITSELF ON ITS FIRST RUN: consult_all_tiers came back NOT CAUGHT -- the rule I had just added to stop a dead ledger reporting every genuine miss as SUBSTRATE_UNAVAILABLE, and NOTHING tested it, because this battery's own fixture sets $NERVES_LEDGER and therefore makes every tier ALIVE. declared_exclusions.item: bundle_identity.py --check reporting MATCH before and after
declared_exclusions.reason: It reports STALE BOTH before and after, and not because of this change. --check compares the WHOLE derivation record including derived_at_commit / validator_commit / schema_commit, all of which move with HEAD, so it reads STALE whenever BUNDLE_IDENTITY.json was written at an earlier commit. MEASURED: contract_bundle_id is byte-identical (bundle:sha256:87ed7080...) before and after, the candidate_id is unchanged, and 0 members differ. The substantive invariant AC2 is protecting -- the contract does not move -- HOLDS; the tool's verdict is about provenance pointers, not about the bundle. Regenerating BUNDLE_IDENTITY.json is the label owner's act, not this TO's.

nerves_lexical.py:143 computes ambiguity itself as len(node_ids) > 2, while the resolver now states AMBIGUOUS at > 1. The caller's threshold predates the contract and disagrees with it by one. It is NAMED here for the module owner; the TO's subject is nerves_resolve.py and the lane grant is an EXACT-FILE row, so editing a caller would be both out of subject and out of lane.

declared_exclusions.item: a persistent production ledger for the resolver to read
declared_exclusions.reason: The ledger substrate is a published snapshot named by $NERVES_LEDGER, normally unset. That is deliberate: an unset variable reports UNAVAILABLE with that as the reason, so 'no ledger configured here' and 'the ledger is empty' stay different answers. Siting a production snapshot is WP-5's business, not this TO's.

declared_exclusions.item: the 7 arms that a bare git-archive extract cannot exercise
declared_exclusions.reason: .comp-graph/graph.json is gitignored and an archive extract carries no .git, so the trace-graph and tracked-index tiers have no substrate there. Those arms report NOT_EXERCISABLE (exit 3) rather than passing or failing, and the mutation proof is SUPPRESSED whenever anything was skipped -- a proof run against whichever arms happened to be exercisable would measure a subset and report it as the whole.
